title: A 10-micron crystal in superposition would test OR

statements.text: Effects of OR should begin to show if a 10-micron cube of crystalline material is held in a superposition of two locations about a nuclear diameter apart for seconds or minutes.

sources.quote: one ought to begin to see the effects of this OR scheme if a small object, such as a 10-µm cube of crystalline material could be held in a coherent superposition of two locations
